agent_final_answer:
Completed the comparison on cars.com. I opened the "Compare cars side by side" tool (Research -> 2023 Audi A7 research page -> Compare similar vehicles -> "Try it now"), set the first car to a 2023 Audi A7 and the second car to a 2023 Audi A6, clicked "See the comparison", and then enabled the "Hide similarities" toggle (now switched ON / green).

Cars compared:
- 2023 Audi A7 - Starting MSRP $70,200 - Prestige 55 TFSI quattro
- 2023 Audi A6 - Starting MSRP $56,900 - Premium Plus 45 TFSI quattro

Key differences shown (A7 vs A6):
- Engine Type: Intercooled Turbo Gas/Electric V-6 vs Intercooled Turbo Gas/Electric I-4
- Horsepower: 335 hp vs 261 hp
- SAE Net Torque @ RPM: 369 @ 1370 vs 273 @ 1600
- Displacement: 3.0 L/183 vs 2.0 L/121
- MPG: 21 City / 30 Hwy vs 24 City / 31 Hwy

Shared specs such as All Wheel Drive, 5 seating capacity, 4 yr / 50,000 mi basic warranty, and the 7-Speed A/T transmission were the similarities, and the "Hide similarities" feature was turned on.
